QuestInfo.name: The Truth
QuestInfo.1: The truth of what lies in the temple is cruel.
QuestInfo.0: When you finally enter the temple and see it for yourself, you realize things were far worse than you suspected.
QuestInfo.2: You told Eight, no, Nine, to take the neutralizer. It played out just like it has every time before. What have you been doing to your friend all this time?

0.msg: This girl is no monster. What is she doing here in the Temple?
